evals.name: scaffold-and-schema
evals.prompt: Create a new Apify actor named 'news-scraper' that takes a list of URLs and scrapes the main headline and publication date. Set up the input and dataset schemas. Don't implement the crawling logic yet, just the structure and schemas.
evals.expected_output: A directory .actors/news-scraper/ with .actor/actor.json, input_schema.json, and dataset_schema.json correctly defined.

evals.name: implement-crawler
evals.prompt: Implement the 'news-scraper' actor in .actors/news-scraper/ using CheerioCrawler. It should scrape the <h1> for the headline and a <meta name='pubdate'> or similar for the date. Include error handling and data pushing. Assume the structure from the previous step exists.
evals.expected_output: A src/main.ts file with correct CheerioCrawler implementation, using Actor.getInput and Actor.pushData.

evals.name: external-client-script
evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript script in scratch/run_news_scraper.ts that uses apify-client to run the 'news-scraper' actor (ID: 'user/news-scraper') with the URL 'https://example.com/news/1'. Log the run ID and the first item from the dataset.
evals.expected_output: A scratch/run_news_scraper.ts file that uses ApifyClient, handles the API token from process.env.APIFY_TOKEN, and correctly calls actor.start().
